name: STAT 5735
title: Linear Models II
description: Multiple comparisons, fixed effects linear models, random-effects and mixed-effects models, generalized linear models,variable selections, regularization and sparsity,  support vector machines, additive models and Bayesian linear models.
requirement_description: STAT 5505, 5605, and 5725; open to Ph.D. students who have passed the Ph.D. Qualifying Exam in Statistics; others with permission.
